intended_object: The i-th face map δ_i : [n] → [n+1], for 0 ≤ i ≤ n+1, viewed as a generating morphism of the simplex category presented by generators (faces and degeneracies) and the simplicial identities. Inferred from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation: `SimplexCategoryGenRel` is defined as the quotient of the path category on `FreeSimplexQuiver` by the simplicial identities. That quiver has objects ℕ and one generating arrow δ i : n → n+1 for each i : Fin (n+2), and one generating arrow σ i : n+1 → n for each i : Fin (n+1). This definition takes the generator δ i, makes it a length-one path with `Paths.of`, and sends it to the quotient category with `Quotient.functor`. That is exactly the i-th face generator of the category given by this presentation. The indexing is right: Fin (n+2) gives i ∈ {0, …, n+1}, which is the range of face maps from [n] to [n+1]. The construction is specific to this presented category, so it cannot be stated more generally. Its counterpart in the concrete simplex category is `SimplexCategory.δ`, and the canonical functor `toSimplexCategory` sends this generator to it.
